blurb: Guests can sail aboard historic vessels, rent kayaks and paddleboards, take sailing lessons, and participate in educational STEM and marine science programs. The center operates on Oyster Bay Harbor and offers both public and private sailing experiences. Programs include living history events, outdoor field trips, and virtual learning options.
extraNote: Guests must check in at least 15 minutes before scheduled start time · Late arrivals may forfeit reservation without refund · Sailing portion subject to safe weather and operating conditions · Private charters may be canceled or rescheduled due to weather, staffing, or vessel availability · The WaterFront Center building, 1 West End Avenue, Oyster Bay, NY 11771
